en.name: Dry gravy mix
en.summary: Dry gravy mix is a starch-and-seasoning powder you make up with water or pan juices. Unopened in the cupboard it keeps about 2 years from purchase. The prepared gravy is the perishable half: 1–2 days in the fridge, and no longer.
en.pantry: An unopened packet or tub keeps about 2 years from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard. Dry is the operative word — gravy granules draw moisture out of the air and set into a block, and a caked mix will not dissolve smoothly. Keep packets away from the hob, off the top of the fridge, and out of any cupboard that catches steam. Once a packet is opened, decant the rest into an airtight jar rather than rolling the paper down.
en.fridge: The refrigeration time applies to the prepared product: made-up gravy keeps 1–2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and that is a short window by design. Gravy is a thick, low-acid, starchy liquid that cools slowly and reheats unevenly, which is exactly the profile bacteria like. Cool it fast in a shallow container, refrigerate within two hours, and reheat to a full rolling boil, stirring, rather than warming it through. The dry mix itself should stay out of the fridge, where condensation ruins it.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for dry gravy mix, and freezing a powder gains nothing while risking condensation in the packet. Prepared gravy is a poor freezer candidate too: starch-thickened sauces separate and go watery or grainy after thawing, and a flour-based gravy usually needs whisking and re-thickening to be presentable. Make up the quantity you will serve.
spoilage: A hard caked block in the packet that will not break up
A stale or rancid smell from the fat and dried meat solids in the mix
Insects or webbing in an opened packet
Prepared gravy that smells sour, has a film on the surface, or is ropy when stirred
tips: Decant opened packets into an airtight jar with the mixing instructions cut from the packet.
Keep the jar away from steam and heat; damp is what ends a dry mix.
Make up only what you will serve — the prepared gravy has a very short life.
Cool leftover gravy in a shallow dish, not in the jug it was served from.

faq.q: How long does dry gravy mix last?
faq.a: About 2 years from purchase, unopened in a cool dry cupboard.

faq.q: How long does made-up gravy keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days at 4 °C or below. Cool it quickly and reheat it to a full boil.
No timeline is given and it is a poor candidate — starch-thickened sauces separate and go grainy on thawing.

faq.q: Why has my gravy mix gone solid in the packet?
faq.a: It has absorbed moisture from the air. Store it airtight, away from steam, and use a dry spoon.

zh.name: 肉汁醬粉
zh.summary: 肉汁醬粉是用澱粉和調味料做成的粉，加水或鍋底肉汁調開使用。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 2 年。調好的肉汁醬才是容易壞的那一半：冷藏 1～2 天，不能再久。
zh.pantry: 未開封的粉包或罐裝放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 2 年。關鍵字是「乾燥」——醬粉會從空氣中吸水結成硬塊，結塊後就調不開了。請遠離爐火，不要放在冰箱上方，也不要放在會被蒸氣熏到的櫃子裡。開封後把剩下的倒進密封罐，不要只把袋口捲起來。
zh.fridge: 冷藏期限講的是調好的成品：調好的肉汁醬放 4 °C 以下可放 1～2 天，這個窗口短是有原因的。肉汁醬濃稠、低酸、含澱粉，降溫慢、回鍋又容易受熱不均，正是細菌喜歡的條件。請用淺容器快速降溫、兩小時內冷藏，回鍋時邊攪邊煮到大滾，不要只是加溫。乾粉本身則不要放冰箱，冷凝水會毀了它。
zh.freezer: 肉汁醬粉沒有提供冷凍期限，冷凍粉末也沒有好處，只會讓包裝內產生冷凝水。調好的肉汁醬同樣不適合冷凍：澱粉勾芡的醬汁解凍後會分離、出水或變粗，麵粉基底的還得重新攪打勾芡才能上桌。請只調這一餐要用的量。
spoilage: 包裝裡結成敲不散的硬塊
聞起來有陳味或油耗味，那是粉裡的油脂和肉粉走味
開封的包裝裡有蟲或蟲絲
調好的醬發酸、表面結膜，或攪動時出現絲狀黏稠
tips: 開封後倒進密封罐，並把包裝上的沖調說明剪下貼上。
遠離蒸氣和熱源；毀掉乾粉的是潮濕。
只調吃得完的量——調好的醬壽命很短。
剩下的醬用淺盤降溫，不要留在上桌的醬汁壺裡。

faq.a: 未開封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 2 年。

faq.q: 調好的肉汁醬放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下 1～2 天。要快速降溫，回鍋要煮到大滾。
沒有提供期限，而且並不適合——澱粉勾芡的醬解凍後會分離變粗。

faq.q: 醬粉為什麼在包裝裡變硬塊？
faq.a: 它吸了空氣中的水分。請密封、遠離蒸氣，並使用乾燥的湯匙。
